evals.prompt: Add a fourth book to Lámina: 'Ranas', the frogs of Costa Rica — six plates (red-eyed tree frog, strawberry poison frog, glass frog, golden toad, Mexican burrowing toad, gladiator frog), each with a 5-second animation. Make it as good as Serpientes.
evals.expected_output: A registered, validated, fact-checked book with a new 'frog' figure subject that renders in the reader on WebGPU and WebGL 2.
assertions: src/books/ranas.js exists, is registered in src/books/index.js and `node scripts/validate-books.mjs ranas` reports 0 errors

Both editions exist: src/books/es/ranas.js is registered as the book's `es` loader, BRIEFS.ranas is recorded verbatim in src/books/making/index.js (with its source in docs/prompts/) and translated in making/es.js, and `node scripts/validate-books.mjs ranas --lang all --fit` reports 0 errors
A 'frog' subject is registered in src/subjects/index.js and exports createFigure(params, ctx) returning root, title, duration 5, layers, labels, parts (with colours) and update
update(t) is a pure function of t: `node scripts/audit.mjs` reports no seam failure for the Ranas plates
New label ids are added to the canonical lists in docs/architecture/CONTRACTS.md §6 and scripts/validate-books.mjs
docs/books/ranas-research.md exists with sources and a fact-check log produced by at least two independent checkers
The golden toad is described as extinct (IUCN EX), not as a living species
Screenshots of every plate were taken on both WebGPU and ?gl=webgl and reviewed

evals.prompt: On the Flores book the orchid's leaves go off the top of the screen on my laptop. Fix it without making the book smaller on the other plates.
evals.expected_output: Framing that includes the active figure's fitted box only when it exceeds the spread.
assertions: The fix unions the active figure's fitted bounds (FigureHost m.box × m.fitScale at the recto anchor) into the camera rig's fit box instead of shrinking FIGURE_AREA for every figure
Plates whose figures fit inside the spread keep the ~95% width framing
The guaria morada plate is screenshotted at 1440×900 and 1600×1000 with nothing clipped

evals.prompt: Export every figure of Calaveras as an SVG colouring page and as a colour plate, and put them in docs/outputs.
evals.expected_output: Two SVGs per plate captured from a production build.
assertions: Uses scripts/capture.mjs (or exportSVG via window.lamina / scripts/export-svg.mjs) rather than hand-written SVG
Runs the capture against `vite build` + `vite preview` (or explains why), not the reloading dev server
Produces <plate>-line.svg and <plate>-color.svg for all six lessons and opens at least one to check it
Line-art SVGs contain outlines only (colouring page); colour SVGs contain part fills

evals.prompt: Someone says the background of the book page is light grey instead of white on their machine. What's going on and how do we fix it?
evals.expected_output: Explains clear-colour tone mapping in WebGPURenderer and the transparent-canvas fix.
assertions: Identifies that WebGPURenderer tone-maps the clear colour / scene.background, so #ffffff becomes grey
Fix: never set scene.background; alpha: true, setClearColor(0xffffff, 0) over a CSS #fff page
Suggests verifying by sampling a corner pixel of a screenshot (expect 255,255,255) on both backends

evals.prompt: Make me an interactive 3D encyclopedia of Costa Rican butterflies in a new folder ~/sites/mariposas.
evals.expected_output: A bootstrapped project with a butterfly book plan and the workflow to fill it.
assertions: Runs .claude/skills/lamina/scripts/bootstrap.mjs ~/sites/mariposas (without --with-books) and npm install
Plans 6–8 plates with figure params, layers, canonical label ids and a 5-second story per plate before writing code
Proposes or creates a reusable wing kit (or extends kits/petal) instead of hand-modelling each species
Runs the accuracy protocol (author → two adversarial checkers → reviser) for the text

evals.prompt: In the open-jaw skull lesson, make the condyle glide forward from the very start of opening instead of only after a third of the way.
evals.expected_output: A pure-function-of-t change to the jaw motion with beats and panels kept consistent.
assertions: Edits jawMotion in src/subjects/skulls/lessons.js so glide is non-zero as soon as the jaw opens, keeping the loop seamless
Checks that the manifest animation.beats for open-jaw still describe what is on screen at their times
Verifies in lab.html at several t values (and the seam with scripts/audit.mjs)

evals.prompt: Ranas exists in English now. Add its Spanish edition so it reads in both languages like the other books.
evals.expected_output: A composed, validated Spanish edition plus the frog figure's Spanish strings, fitted and reviewed.
assertions: src/books/es/ranas.js mirrors src/books/ranas.js (same keys and list lengths, plate ids and lookCloser labels kept, every lookCloser has a Spanish name of ≤ 3 words, locale 'es'), and `node scripts/validate-books.mjs ranas --lang es` reports 0 errors
Ids, numbers, theme and figure params are not changed; binomials stay identical and in *italics*; numbers use the decimal comma and U+00A0 (never U+202F)

The frog subject's figure strings are translated in its own dictionary (src/i18n/es/<folder>.js, registered in src/i18n/es/index.js); `node scripts/audit.mjs ranas --lang es --i18n --json out.json` reports no missing string and no Spanish label over 110 px, and `node scripts/validate-books.mjs ranas --lang es --runtime out.json` reports 0 errors (every look-closer name is exactly its label's Spanish pill)
`LAMINA_URL=… node scripts/validate-books.mjs ranas --lang all --fit` passes: same page sequence and folios in both languages, no overflow or hOverflow, every page ≥ 90 % and the making pages ≥ 25/26
The translation went through the two-lens review of references/accuracy.md (fidelity and language) and the golden toad is still described as extinct (IUCN EX → «Extinto»)
The reader was screenshotted at #/es/ranas on WebGPU and ?gl=webgl, desktop and phone, including a switch to English on a plate that keeps the spread and the moment

evals.prompt: In the Spanish Serpientes on my phone, one of the matabuey's labels ends in an ellipsis. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: A shorter, still correct Spanish label in the snakes dictionary, measured under the pill limit.
assertions: Finds the label with `node scripts/audit.mjs serpientes --lang es --i18n` (or the lab at &lang=es) rather than guessing
Changes only the Spanish value in src/i18n/es/snakes.js (the English key in src/subjects/snakes stays), keeping it a correct name for the same structure
The new value measures ≤ 110 px at 12.5 px in the UI font and the audit reports no Spanish label over the limit
Verifies at 390×844 on #/es/serpientes?plate=5 with labels on, reading the screenshot
